faq.q: What does an AI fashion model photo show?
faq.a: Your clothing or accessory on a generated person. You start with a flat product photo and get a worn image for the store.

faq.q: How do AI model photos for clothing get made?
faq.a: Upload a flat garment photo, choose an adult look and a scene, then generate. Check the color and cut against your reference photo.

faq.q: Can I put my products on a generated person?
faq.a: Yes. Upload the product photo, pick a generated adult, and download the worn view. Do not present that person as a real customer or a celebrity.

faq.q: Which products can I put on an AI model?
faq.a: Tops, dresses, outerwear, bags, and jewelry on model photos work from a clear product photo. Eyewear does too. A flat photo with the whole item in frame beats a wrinkled one.

faq.q: How should I compare this with a studio shoot?
faq.a: You skip the casting and the studio date. You still compare color, seams, and drape with the garment you ship. The photo is not a substitute for a fit model.

faq.q: Is there an API, and can I run a batch?
faq.a: Yes. Send several garment photos through the API, or upload them as a batch and reuse one saved look. Each image uses 24 credits, shown before it runs.

faq.q: Can I publish these photos on my store?
faq.a: Yes, on a product page or a social post. Keep a plain product photo for measurements. Downloads have no watermark and are licensed for commercial use.

faq.q: Can I choose the look and save it?
faq.a: Yes. Choose an adult look, a pose, and a scene, then save that look in your brand library for the next drop. The person is generated.

faq.q: Does the image prove how clothing fits?
faq.a: No. It does not show your size, your body, or a guaranteed drape. Publish measurements and a size chart with the photo.

faq.q: Will garment details stay the same?
faq.a: They should follow the reference photo, but small prints and seams can shift. Compare before you publish. The guide to [model photos without a photoshoot](page:blog-model-photos-without-a-photoshoot) covers that check.

steps.prompt: Use the uploaded flat heather-gray pullover hoodie as the exact garment reference. Preserve its gray color, hood, two drawstrings, kangaroo pocket, seams and relaxed cut.
